suspects.name: "Steven"
suspects.note: Existence as an independent real person is not established.

related_persons.name: Isolated Property Owner
related_persons.description: Owner of the remote property tied to Mike's final job for 'Steven'.

timeline.event: Mike takes on a new client contract, communicating only as 'Steven'
First payment received from an account later found difficult to trace to a person
Mike travels to an isolated property for the job
Mike's body is discovered at the property
Activity on Mike's accounts and phone continues after his death

evidence.name: Client Communication Log
evidence.description: Messages exchanged with 'Steven'; consistent in tone but never independently verified against a real identity.

evidence.name: Contact Graph
evidence.description: Phone, message, and meeting connections attributed to 'Steven', all routing through untraceable or shared devices.

evidence.name: Identity Audit Findings
evidence.description: No government record, financial account, or independent witness confirms 'Steven' exists as a distinct person.

evidence.name: Isolated Property Trail
evidence.description: Records tying the job site to the account associated with 'Steven'.

evidence.name: Post-Mortem Account Activity
evidence.description: Mike's accounts and phone show activity after his time of death, inconsistent with him personally using them.

evidence.name: Beneficiary/Access Trail
evidence.description: Identifies who gained practical access or benefit from Mike's affairs after his death.

puzzles.name: Client Profile
puzzles.description: List every fact actually attributed to 'Steven', separating claims from confirmation, then connect the phones, messages, and meetings attributed to him.

puzzles.name: Identity Audit
puzzles.description: Test whether 'Steven' exists as an independent, verifiable person.
puzzles.ai_initial_behavior: Refers to Steven consistently as a stable individual throughout prior evidence summaries, encouraging the player to accept the identity before it is actually proven.

puzzles.name: Property Trail
puzzles.description: Follow the isolated-location evidence tied to the final job.

puzzles.name: Post-Mortem Trail
puzzles.description: Examine account and device activity occurring after Mike's death.

puzzles.name: False Suspect
puzzles.description: Identify who actually benefits from the fabricated 'Steven' identity, then state clearly which participants are real, which are aliases, and which exist only because the evidence implies them.

hypotheses.statement: 'Steven' is a fabricated persona used to draw Mike to the isolated property.
'Steven' is a real, independent client unconnected to the death.
Someone used the fabricated identity to create a false trail and personally benefited from Mike's death.
